games.title: Bee Hunt 3D
games.tagline: Puzzle game where tapping boxes sends bees out to clear voxels from a picture.
games.coverAlt: Bee Hunt 3D app icon: a smiling yellow bee holding a large yellow cube, with pink, green and purple cubes flying around against a blue sky.

screens.alt: Level 10: a voxel picture of a white and red bird being cleared by bees, with a row of numbered boxes below and two locked boosters at the bottom.
Level 2: a voxel picture of an orange and white cat with a few bees at its tail, a row of empty slots and a grid of numbered boxes below.
Level 15: a voxel picture of a mug with a foamy top being cleared by blue and orange bees, with numbered boxes and booster buttons below.
Level 14: a pink voxel elephant on a patch of grass surrounded by a swarm of green and pink bees, with numbered boxes below.
Level 17: a voxel toucan being cleared by yellow, red and blue bees, with numbered boxes below.
Level 20: a voxel picture of a yellow crescent moon and a brown cat in a witch hat, with a swarm of bees and numbered boxes below.

description: Bee Hunt 3D is a puzzle game where you tap boxes to send bees out to clear voxels from a picture. Merging three same-colored boxes is a core part of the loop.

Early tests showed weak retention, and the task of improving it landed with me. I doubled the number of bees released after each merge, which shifted the focus from clearing the picture to chasing merges. That change took day-one retention from 22% to 38%.
games.role: I worked as a level design consultant.

games.title: Bubble Bus
games.tagline: A color sorting game with a twist: drive buses, park them in the right spots and collect matching color bubbles.
games.coverAlt: Bubble Bus app icon: a yellow cartoon bus with eyes carrying a pile of colorful balls on its roof against a blue sky.

screens.alt: Level 772: a large bubble picture at the top, parking slots with a green truck in the middle and ice-covered numbered vehicles below, next to a smiling bus driver and the caption 'Stress reliever!'.
Level 92: a bubble picture at the top and a parking area below with colored trucks showing direction arrows, with a driver holding a phone and the caption 'Endless fun!'.
Level 724: orange bubbles flowing from the picture into trucks in the parking slots, with stone blocks and numbered vehicles below, a smiling driver with crossed arms and the caption 'Think fast!'.
Level 78: a large bubble picture with several characters at the top and columns of colored trucks below, with a thoughtful driver and the caption 'Train your brain!'.
Level 45: a bubble picture of a brown animal face at the top and a tangle of colored trucks pointing in different directions below, with skip level, shuffle, sort and VIP buttons.

description: Bubble Bus is a color sorting puzzle game with a twist. You drive buses, park them in the right spots and collect matching color bubbles. It is published by MOONEE, and it is live and still in development.
It has passed one million downloads on Google Play, holds 4.7 stars from over 30,000 App Store ratings, and has supported a user acquisition budget of over $5M.
games.role: I am the head designer. I defined the design framework for the team and shaped how the game was designed as a whole.

games.title: Loop Train
games.tagline: Block-jam puzzle with a looping twist, themed around trains and their passengers.
games.coverAlt: Loop Train app icon: a yellow train running along a curved dark track against a blue sky.

screens.alt: Level 10 on a grey and green board: passenger queues on the left, a numbered tunnel and trains waiting on three tracks, with two ability slots still locked.
Level 6 on a green board: colored trains wait on three tracks at the bottom, passengers queue at stations, and two ability slots are locked until levels 15 and 20.
Level 16 on a pale blue board: a looping track with several passenger queues, a numbered tunnel and trains in red, blue and yellow.
Level 21 on a pale blue board: several passenger queues along the left and trains in many colors circling the track.
Level 26 on a snowy blue board: numbered tunnels, a frozen river crossing the map and trains in yellow, green and pink waiting at the bottom.
Level 31 on a green board: a long queue of colored passengers at the top and trains on tracks around the board, with three ability buttons at the bottom.
Level 43 on a green board: numbered tunnels on the left, trains parked on side tracks and three ability buttons at the bottom.
Level 46 on a sand-colored board: a branching track with numbered tunnels and trains in red, green and blue.
Level 50 on a sand-colored board: a larger layout with two sections, numbered tunnels, passenger queues and trains in several colors.

description: Loop Train is a mobile game that combines a looping feel with block-jam mechanics, themed around trains and their passengers.
games.role: I was the project owner and lead designer. The concept, level design, balance and monetization were mine, and I also made the graphics.

games.title: Numbala
games.tagline: Arcade math-training game for children, supporting dyscalculia therapy.
games.coverAlt: Numbala key art: the game logo above a smiling girl with purple hair in a red coat and her brown dog, with two award laurels for Indie Prize Best Game Art and Digital Dragons Editor's Choice, both 2018.

screens.alt: A small spacecraft flies through a desert-like level and fires at a target; a number strip with a highlighted 6 is at the bottom, under the caption 'Cool game that trains math'.
A spacecraft in a green forest level with the task 1 + 3 shown at the top and a number strip at the bottom, under the caption 'Add, subtract and avoid missiles'.
The spacecraft collection screen showing 'Primala' with a girl and her dog in space helmets, a star counter at 0 of 24 and the caption 'Collect new spacecraft'.
A boss encounter with a robot pirate on the right and the player's spacecraft on the left, under the caption 'Face the mean Corsair!'.

description: Numbala is an arcade game and cognitive training for children. It combines a dynamic shooter mechanic with learning math and supports dyscalculia therapy.
It was released in October 2018 on Nintendo Switch, iOS and Android and built in Unity. Today it is available only on Nintendo Switch; the iOS and Android versions have been withdrawn.
The team had 10 people: developers, artists and researchers in cognitive science and computer science.
games.role: I was the idea author and project owner. I was responsible for game design and level design, and I led the scientific research connected with the game, which resulted in a scientific publication.

games.title: Word Finder 3D
games.tagline: A relaxing 3D word-search game inspired by Boggle.
games.coverAlt: A list of found and remaining words in white boxes (INN and ZOO crossed out) above a 3x3 grid of letter tiles with the word FIX being swiped, on a blue background.

screens.alt: Level 5: a 3x3 letter grid with a swipe path highlighted across the letters L, A, N, D, and a word list at the top where NERVE is crossed out.
Level 27: a letter grid with the word SHOWE being swiped, a loose tile R beside it, and a word list with VITAL, DETAIL, STEEL and EQUITY crossed out and SHOWER half revealed.

A bonus round on a green background with a stopwatch and the instruction 'Find as many words as possible containing the letter in pink', above a 3x3 grid with the pink letter O in the center and a 'Tap to start' button.
A bonus screen on a green background with the message 'Find 8-letter words to get the prize!' above a ring of eight letter tiles around an empty center, with a 'Tap to start' button.

description: Word Finder 3D is a relaxing 3D word-search game inspired by Boggle, built around a layered system where clearing a letter reveals another beneath it. Soft-launched by Voodoo on iOS and Android with D1 retention of 42% and D7 retention of 12%.
games.role: I did the game design, level design, balance and art.

games.title: Bubble Chain
games.tagline: Physics puzzle: rotate a tower of colored spheres, then fire a harpoon to snag a chain of matching bubbles.
games.coverAlt: Level 4: a tall white tower covered in colored bubbles, a rope of blue bubbles being pulled up toward a spiked ring at the top, with goal counters at the top left and a moves counter reading 27.

screens.alt: Level 6: a chain of green bubbles pulled up the white tower toward a spiked ring, with red, pink and green goal counters and 17 moves left.
Level 5: a long chain of pink bubbles pulled up the tower, with the orange goal completed and 16 moves left.
Level 4: a rope tip pointing down at a tower covered in colored bubbles, with a patch of pale transparent bubbles in the middle and 28 moves left.
Level 1: a chain of blue bubbles pulled up the tower, with red, blue and orange goal counters and 27 moves left.

description: Bubble Chain is a physics-based puzzle where players swipe to rotate a tower of colored spheres, then release to fire a harpoon that snags a connected chain of matching-colored bubbles.
The prototype was tested with Voodoo, and its best results were D1 retention of 46%, D7 retention of 14% and cumulative playtime over 3 days of 59 minutes.
games.role: I did the concept, game design, level design, balance and graphics.
